p_num, k_num = map(int, input().split())

MODULO = 1000000007

if k_num == 0:
    res = 1
    for _ in range(1, p_num):
        res = (res * p_num) % MODULO
    print(res)
else:
    perm = [0] * p_num
    visited_nodes = [False] * p_num

    for i in range(1, p_num):
        perm[i] = (k_num * i) % p_num

    total_ans = 1
    for start_point in range(p_num):
        if not visited_nodes[start_point]:
            cycle_size = 0
            current_index = start_point
            product_modulo = 1
            while not visited_nodes[current_index]:
                visited_nodes[current_index] = True
                current_index = perm[current_index]
                cycle_size += 1
                product_modulo = (product_modulo * k_num) % p_num
            if cycle_size == 1:
                factor = p_num if k_num == 1 else 1
                total_ans = (total_ans * factor) % MODULO
            else:
                assert product_modulo == 1
                total_ans = (total_ans * p_num) % MODULO
    print(total_ans)
</translated_code>
